_meta.description: Conventional cooling (refroidissement) parameters of the 3CL-DPE 2021 method: cooling setpoint, seasonal efficiency (SEER/EER) of the cooling generator per climate-zone group and installation period, cooling intermittence coefficient, and the effective internal heat capacity Cin per inertia class used by the summer utilization factor.
_meta.source: Annexe 1 (méthode de calcul 3CL-DPE 2021) de l'arrêté du 31 mars 2021 modifié, §10 'Calcul de la consommation de froid (Cfr)' (pages 67-70), version consolidée publiée sur rt-re-batiment.developpement-durable.gouv.fr (consolide_annexe_1_arrete_du_31_03_2021_relatif_aux_methodes_et_procedures_applicables.pdf), transcription verbatim.
_meta.notes: Cfr = intermittence x Bfr / EER with EER = eer_from_seer_factor x SEER (§10.3). The 'before_2008' column is published as an EER directly (footnote '*EER'): eer_direct = true skips the 0.95 factor. Unknown installation period maps to 'from_2015' (documented app convention, deviation D-20: the French residential AC stock is overwhelmingly recent). V1 assumes the whole dwelling is cooled (official rule prorates Cfr by the cooled floor-area share when partial - D-20). Cin drives the cooling time constant t = Cin / (3600 x GV), a = 1 + t/15 (§10.2).

internal_heat_capacity_j_per_k_m2.quote: Légère 110 000*Sh ; Moyenne 165 000*Sh ; Lourde ou très lourde 260 000*Sh (§10.2)
